Controls.Note: Sticky note: click the board to create a note
Controls.Draw: Draw: sketch on the board or on a sticky note

Scene.Name: Name
Scene.CreateHint: Creates a gridless scene shown in the navigation bar. Players can pin and move evidence on it; change that with Accessibility in the scene's configuration.
Scene.RemoveConfirm: Stop treating {name} as an evidence board? Its {count} pinned card(s) will be deleted. The scene itself is kept.

Config.LockedHint: Only GMs can add, move or change evidence while the board is locked.
Config.AccessHint: Who can edit is set by Accessibility above: Owner lets players pin and move evidence, Observer lets them only look.

Surface.Label: Surface
Surface.CreateHint: You can change the surface later in the scene's configuration, and the surrounding colour as its Background Color.
Surface.ConfigHint: Covers the board with a repeating texture inside a frame. A background image set below is drawn on top of it, inside the frame, so use that for a custom picture. The colour around the board is the Background Color.
Surface.FrameReset: Use the surface's own border colour
Surface.FrameHint: Leave it empty to use the surface's own border colour (shown faintly).

Category.Label: Category
Category.ManageHint: Categories show as a coloured tab on each card and group the evidence list. Removing a category leaves its evidence uncategorized.
Category.Name: Name

Folder.Name: Name
Folder.DeleteConfirm: Delete the folder {name}? Its evidence and sub-folders move up a level; nothing is removed from the board.
Folder.NoCycle: A folder can't go inside itself.

Add.Title: Pin Evidence
Add.ImagePlaceholder: Path in your files, or https://…
Add.ImageHint: Web images only appear on the board if their site allows it; upload them if they show as a grey placeholder.
Add.UploadDenied: You don't have permission to upload files. Your GM can grant "Upload New Files" under Game Settings → Configure Permissions.
Add.DropHint: Tip: you can also drop image and PDF files from your computer, images from the file browser, or Actors, Items and Journal entries from the sidebar straight onto the board, or paste an image with Ctrl+V. Pasted text becomes a sticky note.
Add.PdfHint: A PDF in your files, or a web address that allows it. Boards only draw its first page.

Viewer.AddNotes: No notes yet. Use the pencil button to write some.

Notify.NoUpload: You don't have permission to upload files. Ask your GM to grant "Upload New Files", or pin an image by its path or URL.
Notify.NotImage: Only images and PDFs can be pinned.
Notify.NoDocument: The linked document no longer exists.
Notify.NoDocumentPermission: You don't have permission to open the linked document.

Sticker.NoteHint: Click the board to place a note

Journal.Missing: There is no Evidence Journal yet. A GM creates it from the Journal sidebar.
Journal.NoAccess: You don't have access to the Evidence Journal.
Journal.NoBoard: Open a board you can edit to place evidence on it.
Journal.Add: Add an image to the journal
Journal.Empty: No evidence yet. Pin something on a board, or add an image or a text document here.
Journal.SelectHint: Select evidence to see it here. Drag a row onto a board to pin it there.
Journal.RowHint: Click to see it, double-click to go to it on its board, drag onto a board to pin it
Journal.DeletePlaced: {name} is pinned on {count} board(s). Delete it everywhere, or keep the cards on the boards as plain cards?
Journal.FilteredOut: Not shown in the list with the current filter.
Journal.CardDelete: {title} is also in the Evidence Journal. Take it off this board (it stays in the journal), or delete the evidence everywhere?
Journal.AddPdf: Add a PDF to the journal
Journal.ShowPlayersHint: Open it in the players' Evidence Journal: everyone or chosen players, even while it's hidden (Foundry's Show Players)
Journal.NoBoards: There are no evidence boards yet.
Journal.JumpHidden: This evidence is hidden from players: they're taken to the board, but won't see it there. Reveal it first to point it out.

Document.AddPage: Add a page after this one
Document.RemoveConfirm: Remove page {n}? Its text will be lost.
Document.Write: Blank page. Use the pencil button to write on it.
Document.PdfFirstPage: Its first page. The book button reads the whole PDF.
